prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. Three generations plant a young tree in a family garden: a 72-year-old silver-haired grandfather steadies the thin trunk, his 39-year-old daughter with short dark curls adds soil with a small shovel, and an eight-year-old grandchild pours water from a plain watering can. Use distinct natural faces, realistic grips, believable sapling roots and warm afternoon light, with their shared planting action clearly visible. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.
Native image aspect ratio exactly 16:9. Medium-wide environmental framing with all three people and their important actions as one compact group in the middle two-thirds of image width. Leave ordinary courtyard or garden context at both outer edges so that the full heads and key hand gestures remain intact after a central 4:3 crop.
The child holds a real single watering can with one handle and one long spout, supporting it naturally. Water falls from the end of its spout down into the same planting hole. The sapling trunk and the soil-planting action are physically coherent.
review: Wide planting scene shows grandfather steadying one sapling trunk, daughter adding soil with a real hand trowel, and child holding a single handled watering can with its second hand supporting the base. Water exits the spout into the planting hole; roots, soil and grips are physically coherent. Distinct faces and natural continuous garden foreground have no mask or lettering. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and viewed; faces, hands, can/spout, tree and soil action stay readable.
